projectContext: Sprint 14 completes the 3-tier escalation bypass system for yt-dlp downloads. Tier 1 (always-on impersonation via curl_cffi) is fully complete from Sprint 9 - ImpersonationManager wired into all 8 yt-dlp call sites with 31 auto-detected targets and round-robin rotation. Sprint 12 completed EscalationTier enum (IMPERSONATE_ONLY=1, EXTRACTOR_ARGS=2, FULL_BYPASS=3) and EscalationState dataclass in types.py. Sprints 10-13 repeatedly attempted the remaining escalation work but stalled. This sprint takes a focused, minimal approach: (1) ExtractorArgsConfig dataclass, (2) EscalationManager class, (3) wire into all download paths, (4) metrics/logging, (5) comprehensive tests. Pattern to follow: ImpersonationManager's thread-safe round-robin with injection pattern in core.py.

userStories.title: Create EscalationManager class with per-keyword tier tracking
userStories.description: Build the EscalationManager class that orchestrates the 3-tier bypass progression. Tracks escalation state per keyword using EscalationState from types.py, generates yt-dlp --extractor-args for Tier 2+, manages player_client round-robin rotation. Thread-safe with threading.Lock (same pattern as ImpersonationManager).
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/downloader/escalation_manager.py with EscalationManager class accepting ExtractorArgsConfig in __init__
Implement get_tier_args(keyword: str) -> List[str]: Tier 1 returns [] (impersonation handled separately), Tier 2+ returns ['--extractor-args', 'youtube:player_client=<next_client>']
Implement record_403(keyword: str) that increments consecutive_403s and auto-escalates when threshold reached, logging at WARNING level
Implement record_success(keyword: str) that resets 403 counter but keeps current tier (sticky escalation within session)
Implement get_status() -> dict returning per-keyword tier states, escalation counts, and current player_client index
Use threading.Lock for all state mutations (same pattern as ImpersonationManager)
Run: python -m py_compile src/downloader/escalation_manager.py (no errors)
Commit: feat: [US-003] Create EscalationManager with per-keyword tier tracking
userStories.notes: Critical path - unblocks all wiring stories. Uses EscalationTier and EscalationState from types.py. Player_client rotation cycles through ExtractorArgsConfig.player_clients round-robin per keyword.

acceptanceCriteria: Import EscalationManager in core.py and initialize in VideoDownloader.__init__ (pass ExtractorArgsConfig from self.download_config)
In keyword search download path: append escalation_manager.get_tier_args(keyword) to yt-dlp command after impersonation args
In ID-based download path: append escalation_manager.get_tier_args(keyword) to yt-dlp command after impersonation args
On auth error detection in retry loop: call escalation_manager.record_403(keyword) BEFORE existing cookie fallback logic
On successful download: call escalation_manager.record_success(keyword)
Log at WARNING level when escalation occurs: 'Escalating to Tier {n} for keyword: {kw}'
